intro: Costa Rica exports medical devices, bananas, pineapples and coffee, and tourism is huge.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Medical devices are now the top export. Costa Rica is the world's biggest pineapple exporter. Ecotourism brings millions of visitors.

chapters.title: Forest recovery
text: Forest cover has more than doubled since the 1980s.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Costa Rica makes and sells to the world.
